name: Financial Services Credit, KYB/AML & Claims Underwriting
description: Calculates commercial borrower DSCR, net leverage, and interest coverage under multi-shock stress scenarios, resolves multi-hop UBO beneficial ownership with AML velocity/structuring checks, and evaluates insurance claims deterministically.

skills.summary: Calculates DSCR, Net Leverage, Interest Coverage, and Current Ratio across Base, -10%/-20% revenue, and +200bps rate shocks.
Traverses multi-hop holding DAGs to compute cumulative UBO ownership %, enforces 10% EDD drop, and detects velocity/structuring spikes.
Validates policy effective periods and peril exclusions, computes deductible/coinsurance/sublimit payouts, and flags >$100k reserves.
